text: スーパー　おにいさんショー　…って　ほどでも　ないけど　はじめまーす！
note: Hosts of Japanese children's TV shows are traditionally called おにいさん ("big brother") and おねえさん ("big sister"), as on NHK's long-running おかあさんといっしょ. The speaker is casting himself as that kind of kids'-show presenter; the English game renames him the Poké Dude.
claim: On the NHK children's programme Okaasan to Issho, the presenters are called "uta no oniisan" and "uta no oneesan".

check.quote: Daisuke Yokoyama served as the 11th Uta no Onīsan (Singer Brother) from 2008-2017
